title: Coverage End, Survivor Continuation and Activation Terms of the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans
content:
Each tier of the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** carries its own age limit, its own rule for how coverage ends at that limit, its own survivor continuation and its own effect when the sponsor is called to active duty for more than 30 days. An age limit of 0 means the tier has no age limit.

## Terms by tier

| Tier | Age limit (years) | How coverage ends | Family members after the purchaser's death | Call to active duty for more than 30 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | 0 (no age limit) | ends on loss of Selected Reserve status | not applicable | the plan ends on the day before orders of more than 30 days start |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | 0 (no age limit) | ends on loss of Selected Reserve status | family members continue for 6 months after the member's death | the plan ends on the day before orders of more than 30 days start |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | 26 | ends on the last day of the month of the 26th birthday | not applicable | not affected |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | 60 | ends on the day before the 60th birthday | not applicable | not applicable |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | 26 | ends on the last day of the month of the 26th birthday | not applicable | not affected |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | 60 | ends on the day before the 60th birthday | family members continue until the date the member would have turned 60 | not applicable |

## Dates worked from the table (hypothetical birthdays)

- A TRICARE Young Adult Select purchaser whose 26th birthday is 9 March: coverage ends on 31 March, the last day of the month of the 26th birthday.
- A TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only purchaser whose 60th birthday is 9 March: coverage ends on 8 March, the day before the 60th birthday.
- A TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family purchaser who dies on 15 April: the family members continue for 6 months after the member's death.
- A TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family purchaser who dies at 55: the family members continue until the date the member would have turned 60.
